name: Trekking in Forest Area (Scheduled Tribes)
benefit: - **Nature Immersion Experience:** The selected beneficiaries will have the opportunity to participate in a guided forest trekking program designed to foster a love for nature and environmental awareness. - **Exposure to Biodiversity:** Participants will get firsthand experience of pristine natural sites, including forests, wildlife, birds, trees, springs, mountains, and ravines.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. - The applicant should be between 15 and 35 years of age.
